necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology. Given the history of unspecified atrial fibrillation, a 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances and assess for intermittent high-grade block or tachyarrhythmias. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93226 despite the denial under Reason Code PR-204.
